description: Source code defining a transformer-based model with MoE (Mixture of Experts), including classes for model configuration, attention, transformer blocks, and utility functions, used for language modeling or similar tasks.

classes.name: ModelArgs
classes.description: Data class for transformer model configuration parameters, including methods for initialization from preset configs.

classes.name: KVCache
classes.description: Buffer class for caching key and value tensors for attention mechanism, supporting updates.

classes.name: Transformer
classes.description: Main transformer model class with embedding, multiple layers, normalization, and output projection.

classes.name: TransformerBlock
classes.description: A single transformer block containing attention and feedforward submodules.

classes.name: Attention
classes.description: Multi-head attention module with rotary embeddings and optional key-value cache.

classes.name: ConditionalFeedForward
classes.description: Feedforward network with conditional parameters for mixture of experts.

classes.name: MOEFeedForward
classes.description: Mixture of Experts feedforward layer with gating and expert selection.

methods.name: find_multiple
methods.description: Utility function to find the next multiple of k greater than or equal to n.

methods.name: from_name
methods.description: Class method to instantiate ModelArgs from a preset configuration name.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Method in KVCache to update cached key and value tensors at specified positions.

methods.name: setup_caches
methods.description: Method in Transformer to initialize caches and precompute positional encodings.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Forward pass method for Transformer, TransformerBlock, Attention, and other modules.
